rev.title: Reviews
rev.sub: What buyers wrote, checked before anyone sees it. Publish, hide or refuse; mark a real buyer verified. The stars on the shop are the average of the published ones.
rev.readOnly: You can read reviews here; publishing or hiding needs the "Check reviews" permission.

act.paid: Saved. The photo reward went to his wallet: {amount}.

empty.PENDING: Nothing waiting. New reviews come here first.
empty.photo: No reviews with a photo yet.

req.title: Review requests
req.line: Orders asked for a review three days after delivery in the last {days} days: {asked}. Answered: {answered} ({pct}%); with a photo: {photo}.
req.none: No review request has gone in the last {days} days. It goes three days after delivery while the Day-3 step is on in Messages and reviews are switched on.
req.timing: When and how it is asked

set.d: The Day-3 review request's own switch, channel, words and day are in Messages › Order messages. Here: whom it skips and how far back this page counts.
set.readOnly: Only someone who may check reviews can change this.
set.skipReviewedHelp: An order whose every item he has already reviewed is not asked again.
set.resultDaysHelp: How far back "Asked after delivery" counts the requests sent and answered.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this just now; it was read again.
